pre_execution_sequence: Refresh target branch and obtain CURRENT_HEAD.
If equal, record EXECUTION_ALLOWED and continue other preconditions.
If unequal, original command execution is forbidden.
Run semantic-diff between EXPECTED_HEAD and CURRENT_HEAD.
Run first-class change-impact for the original command scope and dependency closure.
If command remains valid, issue a new command that supersedes the original and pins CURRENT_HEAD.
Otherwise mark original command STALE or BLOCKED.
Never rewrite expected_head in the historical original command.
stale_rules: A previously acquired claim cannot override HEAD mismatch.
A PASS from old evidence cannot clear HEAD mismatch.
SUPERSEDE requires explicit semantic_diff_ref + impact_ref + superseding_command_id.
